'''Sankar Palace''' was a palace located on the ventral side of the bridge-city of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the fallen [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Suljo Warde]] battled&mdash;and killed&mdash;two other Jedi in the Palace, along with a group of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] delegates. After the Clone Wars, the Palace was abandoned.<ref name="CotG" />
